description: Hi! My name is Jeremy Boy. I am a strategic leader, interdisciplinary researcher, and open source advocate at the intersection of data science, data for development, responsible data and AI use, information visualization, and digital product design. I bring 15 years of global experience across international public organizations and academia, as well as a past in freelance design. Over the last decade, my work has helped shape both policy and practice inside the UN. I thrive in high-impact environments where advanced computational techniques and data can be combined to address complex socio-technical problems. My background ranges from graphic design and multi-media art to computer science, cognitive psychology, information sciences, and computational social sciences. I am both French and Kiwi.
